newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage rises 15 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage rises 15 pct in Feb.

text.p: The average monthly net wage in Romania rose by 15.0 percent in February, reversing a 8.5 percent fall the previous month, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.
February's net wage rise was well below the 18.8 percent monthly inflation, triggering a 3.2 percent drop in purchasing power, a CNS report said.
It said February's purchasing power was 10.8 percent down year-on-year and was 58.2 percent of the level in October 1990, when price liberalisation started in Romania.
Financial sector employees earned the highest net average monthly wage of 858,290 lei last month, when health, tourism and catering workers had the lowest pay -- 329,986 lei.
Romania employed 5.502 million people at end-February, 5,900 less than the previous month.
